headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for the Tesla Wall Connector (Gen 3) local API.
footerDisplay: The **Matter EnergyEvse** option is forward-compatible: enabling it is a safe no-op on current Homebridge builds and only takes effect once Homebridge exposes the Matter energy device types ([homebridge#3942](https://github.com/homebridge/homebridge/issues/3942)).

ipAddress.title: IP Address
ipAddress.description: Local IP address of the Wall Connector.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (ms)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll /api/1/vitals, in milliseconds.

matter.title: Publish as Matter EnergyEvse device
matter.description: Expose the charger as a Matter EnergyEvse device so it appears in the Apple Home Energy view (iOS 27+). Safe to enable ahead of platform support — no-op until Homebridge exposes the Matter energy device types.
